results.content:
Morning Consult rolls up its poll results over a three-month period to calculate the state approval rating. Surveys conducted April 1-June 30 found 45% of registered voters in Texas approve of Trump's job performance, compared to 52% who disapprove.

The Economist uses weekly YouGov polls to make projections of the state-level approval ratings. In Texas, Trump is also in the red by a margin of 22 percentage points, according to The Economist.
results.title: Trump is headed to Texas. See state midterm election record, polling

results.content: A Morning Consult poll offered less of a grim picture for Republicans but still found him underwater at -14 points, 41 percent approving and 55 percent disapproving of the president’s job performance. It surveyed 2,203 registered voters from August 28 to 30, 2026, according to The New York Times. [...] Meanwhile, Trump’s net approval rating fell to a new low of -32 points in the poll. Thirty-two percent of respondents said they approved of his job performance, while 64 percent disapproved. That’s a decline from a -29 point net approval in March 2026 and a -20 net approval rating in July 2025 in UMass Amherst polling. results.content:
Meagher said Trump’s popularity will be part of the national story surrounding the midterm elections.

“I do think that Trump’s numbers should be concerning to not just the Trump administration and Republicans nationally, but Republicans here in Virginia,” Meagher said.

Morning Consult also found that more than 50% of registered voters in Virginia approve of the jobs U.S. Sens. Tim Kaine (D-Va.) and Mark Warner (D-Va.) are doing.
